subject: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@echelon.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Hi Samira — thanks again for carving out time this morning. Quick follow-up with the items you asked for during the demo:

- Baseline proposal for Hosted API per-token pricing options and commit tiers
- A short mutual action plan (attached) and our ask for a 12-month committed volume for pricing guarantees
- Notes on what we can commit to for audit logs / compliance visibility during the pilot

I've attached your team's forecast so we can align slabs to your expected monthly spread (usage-forecast-Echelon-2027.csv). If you can share the competitor quote in writing I can map to exactly how we'd match or displace.

High-level ask from your side I heard today: match the effective blended per-token economics you're seeing from other providers for the long-tail and give a clear path to committed slab discounts. Correct?

Next steps: if you confirm target blended rate and the shape of your month-to-month variability I'll run the slabized scenarios with finance and come back with 2 options: (A) a 12mo commit with deeper slab discounts, (B) a 3mo pilot + conversion credit into a full commit.

Best,

From: Samira Khan <samira@echelon.ai>

Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Jordan — thanks, received.

Short answers up front: yes, matching economics is the core ask. We are evaluating 2 vendors: one is offering a blended per-token equivalent that ends up ~30-35% lower than our current spend for our expected distribution (heavy short-chat + spikes for batch rerank). They also offered a commitment structure that discounts aggressively after the first 20M tokens / month.

We care about three things beyond headline price:
1) predictable unit economics at scale (we need slab guarantees for months where we spike),
2) visibility / retention of audit logs for security/compliance, and
3) a simple conversion path from pilot to committed contract without re-negotiating heavily.

I'll loop in procurement if we get to a pilot/term draft. Attached is the pricing summary we received in-call (I'll send the official quote via procurement e-mail shortly).

Best,
Samira Khan
CTO, Echelon Systems
samira@echelon.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 12:47:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Samira's reply. Key asks: match effective blended per-token economics they saw elsewhere, slab guarantees for spikes, audit logs, and a simple pilot -> commit conversion.

Options I think we should model for Echelon (they're US-based, predictable SRE team):
- Option 1 (12mo commit): 3 slab levels with step-down per-token pricing; revenue-protected, faster SLA and increased observability retention.
- Option 2 (Pilot -> conversion): 3-month paid pilot with a conversion credit that applies against a 12mo commit if they sign; temporary deeper match for the first 3 months to overcome the incumbent.

Attachments: draft-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan, initial milestones & audit log requirements). Can finance and product vet the slab numbers below and confirm feasibility?

Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Team — my read and a recommended structure we can reasonably offer while protecting margin and giving Echelon a clear displacement path:

Proposed slabs (text generation / chat blended per-1K-token equivalent):
- Bronze (0 - 10M tokens / month): $0.0048 / 1K tokens
- Silver (10M - 50M tokens / month): $0.0031 / 1K tokens
- Gold (50M+ tokens / month): $0.0019 / 1K tokens

Pilot option: 3-month paid pilot at Bronze rates with a conversion credit equal to 40% of pilot spend applied to the first 6 months of a 12-month commit. During the pilot we will provide 30-day retention of audit logs with realtime access; upon conversion we can extend to 12-month retention (enterprise plan).

Competitive match policy: we will match a written competitor commercial (signed or e-mailed quote) for the first 90 days up to a maximum of a 25% discount off our published slab rates above, subject to a standard verification call and reciprocal reference ask. This preserves our standard discounting guardrails.

Notes: finance says the Gold slab is aggressive but viable if this is a full 12-month commit and we get a forecasted monthly minimum. Also recommend adding a quarterly usage review cadence and an automatic rebaseline if actuals +50% above forecast for two consecutive months.

I can draft the commercial terms and updated MAP if you want to present this week.

—Ben
Director, Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Ben / Jordan — looks sensible. A couple of tweaks before we take to procurement:
- Add an optional 90-day break clause in the 12mo to reduce buyer friction (we keep the conversion credit clawback pro-rated if they exit early).
- Offer an introductory 60% audit-log access (realtime) guarantee during the pilot so Echelon has full visibility for their security review team.
- Limit the competitive-match to written commercial quotes and cap at $150k total discount per year to avoid open-ended exposure.

If Ben can update the MAP and the commercial with those lines I can OK sending it to Samira and procurement. Also copy Legal on the first go — we may need a short addendum for the match policy.

Karthik
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@echelon.ai>

Subject: Re: Per-token slab conversion & competitive displacement discussion (Echelon)

Jordan / Ben / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the thoughtful options. Procurement is happy to start with the pilot + conversion credit approach. Two asks before procurement sends the official quote:

1) Please provide the DocuSign link for a 3-month paid pilot with the 40% conversion credit language and 30-day log retention during pilot.
2) Confirm the competitive-match process (we will send the competitor quote as a PDF and calendar the verification call) and the $150k annual cap noted by Karthik.

If those are OK we'll sign pilot SOW and schedule the onboarding runbook for the week of Dec 13.

Samira Khan
